Heading: What this app does
Body: Report measuring points and counters for a functional location. One request can hold many rows.

Heading: Existing or new
Body: An existing measuring point is only registered. A new one is created in SAP by Master Data.

Heading: Counter or measuring point
Body: A new counter is approved by the System Manager for the system of the functional location. A measuring point is not approved.

Heading: Missing counter
Body: If the counter is not in PRODOS yet, the PRODOS/SRO creator for the plant is asked to create it first.
